title: love is patient

verses.text: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.

caption:
Love is not mostly a feeling. Most days it looks like patience.

Paul wrote this to a church that was arguing with itself. He did not tell them to feel more warmly, he told them what love actually does. It waits, it stays kind, it keeps believing when believing is hard.

1 Corinthians 13:4, 13:7 and 13:13 (BSB)
